name: IL-03
label: Safe D

Overwhelming fundraising gap: Ramirez has $927K on hand to Oakley's under $1,000
Prediction markets price Ramirez near 97 percent

model.rationale: A D+17 incumbent district, a roughly 150-to-1 cash advantage for Ramirez, and prediction markets near 97 percent all point the same way; with no contrary polling or spending, a Safe D rating with a low-twenties margin fits the evidence.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing Oakley within single digits would be the first sign of movement, but nothing currently suggests the race is competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
Delia Ramirez enters the general election as a heavy favorite in a Chicago-area district that has leaned Democratic by seventeen points. She has raised about $1.6 million and holds roughly $927,000 on hand, while Republican Angel Oakley has reported about $10,700 raised and under $1,000 in the bank. Prediction markets price Ramirez's chances near 97 percent, and no outside spending has appeared against her.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's financial advantage, and market pricing. Those signals all align, pointing to a comfortable double-digit win for Ramirez. The race has drawn little attention from national raters, consistent with its low competitiveness. A margin in the low-to-mid twenties is the central expectation, with incumbency and the district's strong Democratic lean doing most of the work.
